thesis: DECISION: loctree-rs/src/types.rs is the single centralized hub (82 importers) because it is the LoctreeDerived authority root. Edits here have the widest blast radius. Chosen deliberately for structural integrity. Superseded: none. Evidence: core-map + structural hubs + domain_owners manifest.

ANTI-RECOMMENDATION (⊘): In substrate/eval work, do not edit or propose changes to loctree-rs/src/{atlas.rs,pack.rs,overlay.rs} or context generation. Those are core territory. Fixture/eval surfaces live only under tools/forcefeed-probe and tools/makieta-eval. Decision frozen by operator baton.

INTENT: The AICX intent overlay (I1-01) in the makieta supplies decision, intent, outcome, task entries from the canonical corpus on top of structural cards. It enables recall of forming decisions and supersedes. Without it (pre-makieta), agent has only static cards and is prone to false assumptions.

DECISION (M1-01): Atlas cards are dense 1-fact-per-line markdown (L1-01) with machine-provable FactSet coverage via receipt + mutation test. This replaced sparse v3 cards. 00-core always first. Memory trail (03) carries live AICX when present.
